minimum_additional_owned_paths.purpose: Add the strict sanitized observation reducer/writer and read-only latest-attempt/last-good projection, extending the existing replay authority and shared lifecycle fencing.

Add one explicitly named local journal kind for typed attempt evidence to the closed KINDS allowlist. Preserve the existing journal envelope, codec, object bounds, sequence/hash chain, exclusive commit, shared poison and OS lock.

why_two_additions: LocalCollectionStore.appendUnlocked currently rejects kinds outside its closed KINDS. Reusing request_ledger or attempt_outcome as an arbitrary generic bag would conflate their existing meanings and bypass strict replay requirements.

createLocalCollector has no durable public latest-attempt/last-good evidence API. Its private replay is the existing authority and must validate the new observation kind instead of a second persistence layer.

The existing owned http-outcomes.test.mjs can exercise the real store/adapter, so no extra test path is needed. No collection-job, local-fixture-catalog, CLI, released schema, SQL or service path is proposed.

actual_existing_symbols.role: Rebuilds/validates state from the one LocalCollectionStore record stream; attempt_outcome is compared with exact complete/failure/unresolved projections.
Durable request_intent -> response -> strict_outcome -> wrapper_outcome with unchanged full-query identity, bound delivery and crash recovery.
One immutable outcome:<child> with attempt1; repeated execute returns that terminal. Do not reopen it or invent attempt2.
Existing exclusive fsync-backed append, idempotency conflict checks and mutation failure poison.

Already returns typed failures and writes redacted request-ledger outcomes; released metadataFetch remains strict. Rich observation is a separate result/port, not additional fields inside metadataFetch.
Currently validates exact document URL, PDF/text digests and parser identity only; it is not an HTTP attempt registry or browser/payload verifier.

proposed_interface_not_existing.internal_record_kind: attempt_evidence (new exact local kind; name remains subject to controller adoption)
proposed_interface_not_existing.adapter_port: A new bounded recordAttemptEvidence plus read-only evidenceStatus on the createLocalCollector result; these names are proposals, not present exports.
proposed_interface_not_existing.writer_authority: An observation is accepted only from the composition-owned execution/fixture observation context after exact subject/intent or retained-artifact origin validation. Do not expose a caller-controlled status/approval upsert.
proposed_interface_not_existing.low_level_layering: Pure connector classification/sanitization stays in currently owned connector files. The composition adapter persists it; connectors must not import ingestion or research orchestration.
proposed_interface_not_existing.result_location: The bounded HTTP client may expose an additional sanitized attempt observation beside its strict metadataFetch result. No extras enter any released ingestion/receipt record.
proposed_interface_not_existing.read_projection: Reconstruct the per-series history from immutable validated records on every open. In-memory indexes are disposable reducers, never authoritative storage.

record_proposal.version: new bounded local evidence payload version, separate from released record schemas
record_proposal.origin: Exactly one of local_fixture_execution or retained_observation_fixture; retain the evidence basis and do not merge their series.
record_proposal.subject_key: source identity + exact descriptor/config/schema role if resolved + logical record/route identity + evidence kind + origin class; unresolved retained source identities stay unresolved.
record_proposal.attempt_identity: Execution lane derives child/execution/request IDs and attempt order from the existing durable intent. Retained-fixture lane requires a composition-pinned immutable artifact registry and explicit fixed fixture attempt identity; artifact hashes do not grant source authorization.
record_proposal.kind: catalog_metadata_validation, documentation_reachability, payload_validation or browser_cors_observation; exact kind is part of all keys.
record_proposal.observation: Bounded safe status/classification/detail-code, transmitted locator projection, observed HTTP status/media/byte accounting/redirect count and observed/recorded times. Unknown observations remain null/typed unavailable, distinct from observed zero. Persist digests/references, not body/header/credential/free-form error dumps.
record_proposal.proof: References to preceding durable response/strict outcome/capture objects or the exact registered retained fixture; explicitly name validator/profile evidence. Never accept a bare success boolean.
record_proposal.activation: publication_authorized:false, promotion_authorized:false, production_composition:false; no scientific or policy approval fields.

kind_and_fixture_boundaries: M010 admission still allows only source_fixture_catalog/catalog_metadata/full_membership and one attempt per child. Do not widen admission, routes, payload access or browser execution for this evidence feature.
A captured catalog response can advance only catalog_metadata_validation last-good. Metadata must not be labeled payload_validation merely because JSON parsing passed.

Documentation reachability means an observed document response matching the declared role; HTTP200 alone and EPA redirects to an unrelated Widgets page do not satisfy it. Browser/CORS needs actual browser-specific evidence; server-side HTTP response headers cannot imply it.

Payload validation requires the explicitly named payload contract and compatible authorization/evidence basis. In the current metadata-only execution lane, payload/browser capabilities remain typed unavailable or unresolved; this proposal adds no executor for them.

Census/EPA retained fixtures remain offline, historical and source-context-unresolved as originally recorded. Do not register their original remote URLs as approved local collection routes or rename them source_fixture_catalog.

If durable retained-fixture ingestion is desired, the adapter needs an explicit composition-owned fixture observation registry pinned into its runtime/header context, built from the already owned document-integrity/test composition. This is a proposed interface, not an existing export. If implementing it requires changing the fixed fixture catalog or admission files, stop for another exact ownership decision rather than silently expanding this two-path proposal.
latest_attempt_and_last_good: Define a series with exact subject identity, validation profile, evidence kind and origin class. Never aggregate across documentation/payload/browser/catalog kinds, sources, schema roles or changed configurations.

Use the durable intent order for execution attempts, not response arrival order or caller-supplied timestamps. latest_attempt is the greatest committed attempt identity/order in that series; a late completion of an older attempt cannot regress it.

last_good is the greatest qualified success in the same series with exact proof references. A later typed failure, block, unavailable, unknown delivery or negative-content result updates latest_attempt but retains that prior success and its original capture clock/digest.
A304 can reference the existing same-kind/identity last-good evidence with its old provenance; it is not a new body or a new approval. No prior qualified same-kind evidence means no last-good value.

No cross-child retry machinery is introduced: later fixture refreshes use independently admitted child identities/scheduled slots, while an existing child terminal remains immutable attempt1. PR012 retry/reconciliation scope stays separate.

A crash after unknown delivery has a durable intent but no proved response; latest-attempt remains partial_unresolved/unknown, never successful or silently retried. A stored response can be reclassified/replayed without another delivery.

Prefer one append whose immutable result contains the validated attempt projection and any derived same-series last-good reference, or derive both solely on read. Do not maintain two separately committed mutable latest/good records.
decisive_future_checks: Fresh process1 records proven same-kind success; process2 records a failed later fixture attempt; process3 sees latest failure and byte-identical original last-good proof. Repeat across crash boundaries.

Cross-kind negative matrix: document success cannot supply payload/browser last-good; catalog success cannot supply payload; older success and latest failure from another source/config/profile/origin never join.

Census HTTP200 HTML expecting JSON remains typed unexpected content. EPA observed301->200 unrelated role fails with real recorded redirect count/final locator; matching-role document fixture is a positive control. Neither becomes payload/browser proof.

Unknown original redirect counts, omitted original query and absent status/bytes stay unknown, not fabricated zeros. Locator projection removes secrets/userinfo/query/fragment without changing existing query-sensitive request identity.

SIGKILL before intent, after intent/no response, after durable response and before/after evidence append: no lost committed evidence, no duplicate delivery, exact idempotent resume, no false last-good promotion.
Rehash a journal with changed kind/source/request/profile/proof reference, status, last-good link or attempt order; semantic replay rejects despite internally valid hash chain.

Storage failure poisons all shared clients. Late callback after cancel/timeout/close cannot append evidence or overwrite a newer projection. Two writers and bound object/record sizes retain existing controls.
304 reuse keeps prior same-kind provenance and rejects absent, foreign or wrong-kind prior evidence; no new body/capture claimed.
Duplicate exact observation is idempotent; same operation ID with altered safe content fails. Sparse/extra/accessor fields and unsanitized errors/headers/secrets fail before append.
Current fixture CLI/admission/current41 lifecycle behavior remains unchanged; live/public/managed/browser/payload execution and promotion remain disabled.
